title: Find your way around the workspace
summary: Use the camera, grid views, asset browser, and inspector together while editing a source map.
outcome: You can choose a working view, find a selected object, and reach the controls for its current tool.

sections.title: Choose a view
paragraphs: The Camera shows the map in 3D. Top (XY), Front (XZ), and Side (YZ) are editable grid views. The active view receives view commands.

steps.title: Arrange the views
steps.text: Choose View > Two views or Four views. Click the view you want to work in, then use View > Maximize / restore active view for more room.

steps.title: Change a grid plane
steps.text: Click a grid view's plane label to cycle XY, XZ, and YZ, or choose a plane from View > 2D plane.

steps.title: Find geometry
steps.text: Select an object and choose View > Frame selection in all views. Use Frame all views if the selection is empty or off screen.

sections.caption: The camera and grid views share the current map and selection.

sections.title: Use the panels
paragraphs: The asset browser supplies the active material. The inspector changes with the selected object and tool; it contains context controls such as geometry, terrain, surface, and organization settings.

steps.title: Show a panel
steps.text: Use View > Show / hide asset browser or View > Show / hide inspector. Select an object or activate a tool to expose its relevant inspector controls.

tips: If a field is disabled, select the kind of object named in that panel's hint or switch to the appropriate editing tool.
